args.body: Advance the existing item 4 pilot by producing its decision artifact if neither a copy-ready handoff nor a redacted operator decision is already committed. Use the exact draft and the committed release binding. If the draft needs a correction the verified live offer supports, make the smallest correction and read back the revised draft with its hash and verified destination. Retain one handoff for the authorized operator. If the buyer-specific offer depends on the unpublished revision, record that claim and resume on verified deployment through the independent review gate. Reuse any existing decision. Keep outreach, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement separate. No external send by agents.

description: The catalogue item 4 pilot is the shortest identified route to a buyer response. Its release comparison is committed, and the next step is to establish whether the exact draft supports an operator send-or-decline decision. The commissioned-review revision depends on host-confirmed independent approval of its current digest. Zero classified feedback and five unclassified sources leave demand unknown. The order register is unavailable, and Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.
